decision.title: For LP Fans Only (1959)
tracklist: I'm Left, You're Right, She's Gone

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (10 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/master/286881-Elvis-Presley-For-LP-Fans-Only?redirected=true, https://www.elvisthemusic.com/music/for-lp-fans-only/. 1959 compilation of 1954-1956 singles/sides not previously on LP, 10 tracks. IN-CHUNK DUPLICATE: same album also filed under 'For LP Fans Only' (release_id f0323c4e-8874-4a8a-ae55-9d30131a9030). Note: Wax Time label reissue adds 4 bonus tracks (Baby Let's Play House; Good Rockin' Tonight; I Forgot To Remember To Forget; Blue Moon Of Kentucky) - not included here.
